data.translation: sagte er: "Ich brenne vor Begierde nach Trauben; lass uns an die Trauben gehen."

data.translation: Er weinte sehr, er weinte bitterlich, mit sehr lauter Stimme und bekümmertem Herzen.

summary: Active desire can involve a heart expression and ʕal- desired entity: bare lebi in the inherited human-figure passage versus l lebi with grape craving. The latter cannot be assumed to be a simple nominative heart subject.
Makrable differs from the base mkarable. Its meaning and frame support provisional II placement, but they do not prove its morphological derivation; no III stem or reconstructed base is added.
Detransitive grief is expressed by komikarəb with the son as subject and by Part. Pass. mkarbo with the experiencer represented as the heart's possessor.
Repeated lebo mkarbo in text 58 is one recurrent grief formula. Existing 58/34,37,122 references are preserved; only nonduplicated 58/85 is added.
The inherited Detransitive label 1 describes appetite after excessive sweets or fat, whereas Detransitive 2 is grief. Restoring the missing gloss list does not change their inherited numbering.
